Description: Deal 5 damage and gain 1 Block charge.
Deal 4 damage to every enemy around the target.
Gain 7 Shield and 2 Block charges.
Gain 2 Block charges.
Gain 2 Parry charges.
Deal 12 damage.
Heal 5. The Knight has no healing at all today.
Notes: Fills a real gap: Knight currently has zero heal cards.

Description: Gain 3 Shield and 1 Block charge.
Deal 5 damage and gain 5 Shield.
Gain 15 Shield and 3 Block charges.
Move to a tile, then deal 5 damage to everything adjacent to where you land.
Engine Work: A DashAttackEffect: Move and Damage resolve as separate actions today, so the damage lands around the OLD tile. Needs one effect that moves then strikes from the destination.

Description: Deal 3 damage and push the target 1 tile away.
Notes: Push/pull is the single highest-value addition for a grid game. Unlocks a dozen cards across all three classes.
Engine Work: PushEffect : CardEffect - displace the occupant N tiles along the aim direction, via GridManager.MoveCharacter so move rules and tweens still apply.

Description: You cannot be pushed or pulled this turn.
Notes: Only worth building once push exists.
Engine Work: ImmovableStatus with a DisplacementRefusal gate, plus StatusType.Immovable appended to the enum.

Description: Pull the target 1 tile toward you.
Engine Work: PullEffect - the inverse of PushEffect; both should share one displacement helper.

Description: Summon a totem that deals 3 damage to any enemy standing next to it at end of turn.
Engine Work: A second Totem prefab with a damaging AuraReaction on an end-of-turn trigger. TriggeringActionType has no turn-end entry yet.

Description: You and every adjacent ally gain 2 Block charges.
Swap places with an adjacent ally.
Engine Work: SwapEffect - exchange two occupants. Character.MoveTo assumes the destination is empty, so this needs a paired swap on GridManager.

Description: Taunt the target and gain 2 Block charges.
Notes: Taunt has exactly one card today.

Description: Gain 5 Shield, but you are Rooted - the cost of digging in.
Notes: Rooting yourself is already expressible: Root aimed at Self. A genuine drawback card with no new code.

Description: Move, then Taunt every enemy adjacent to where you land.
Engine Work: Same DashAttackEffect problem as Shield Charge - the second effect must aim from the destination tile.

Description: You and every ally within 2 tiles gain 2 Strength.
Apply 2 Weaken.
Deal 5 damage and apply 3 Weaken.
Your next Shield gain is doubled.
Gain 3 Block charges. Your next Shield gain is doubled.
Deal 5 damage and Root the target.
Your next attack deals double damage.
Gain 3 Strength and draw a card.
Give an ally 5 Shield.
Gain 10 Shield and 5 Block charges. Your next Shield gain is doubled.
Whenever you take damage this turn, deal 3 back to the attacker.
Notes: Fits the Knight fantasy better than anything else on this list.
Engine Work: ThornsStatus with an OnTakeDamage hook that calls TakeDamage on DamageInfo.Source. MaxParryBounces already shows how to stop the recursion.

Description: Your Shield is no longer wiped at the start of your turn.
Notes: Directly answers the balance note that Shield is worse than Block right now.
Engine Work: PersistentShieldStatus, or a flag ShieldStatus checks in its OnTurnStart before clearing.

Description: The next time you Block an attack, deal 5 damage back.
Engine Work: An OnBlocked notification. BlockStatus currently just reduces DamageInfo and tells nobody.

Description: Deal 4 damage. Permanently gains +2 damage each time you play it this battle.
Notes: The Card/CardData split was built for this - it is cheaper than it looks.
Engine Work: Per-copy mutable state on Card (CardData is shared, so the counter cannot live there). Card already exists for exactly this.

Description: Damage dealt to the chosen ally is redirected to you.
Engine Work: RedirectStatus on the ally with an OnTakeDamage hook that forwards to the guardian. Needs a guard against two knights redirecting to each other.

Description: Deal 10 damage. Exhaust.
Notes: Cheapest new keyword to add - CardKeywordEntry was designed for it.
Engine Work: Exhaust as a CardKeywordType plus removal from the pile cycle in Character. The keyword list already exists to be extended.

Description: Deal 5 damage to every enemy in a straight line.
Notes: Possibly buildable already via a painted EffectPattern.
Engine Work: A line/pierce area. EffectPattern can paint a line, so this may only need a Line pattern asset rather than new code - worth checking first.

Description: Deal damage equal to your current Shield.
Notes: Turns the Knight defensive pile into a win condition.
Engine Work: ScalingDamageEffect that reads a stat off the source at resolve time. Actions are stateless, so the value must come from ActionContext.

Description: Gain Shield equal to twice your Block charges.
Deal damage equal to what you took last turn.
Engine Work: A per-turn damage-taken tally on Character, reset on turn start.

Description: Gain 15 Shield and 3 Strength, then draw a card.
Deal 8 damage to everything in a 3x3 area.
Deal 6 damage to everything around you.
Taunt the target. Gain 10 Shield and 5 Block charges.
Deal 15 damage.
Summon a banner granting every nearby ally 1 Strength.
Notes: Nearly free: Totem + AuraData already do auras, there is just no prefab using them.
Engine Work: A Totem prefab with a Strength aura. AuraData already supports this - it needs a prefab authored, not new code.

Description: Every ally within 2 tiles heals 10 and gains 10 Shield.
Deal 10 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.
Gain 5 Block charges and 3 Parry charges.
Notes: Parry 3 would need a Parry 3 effect asset; two entries is the buildable version.

Description: Lose half your health. Deal that much to every enemy within 2 tiles.
Engine Work: SelfDamageEffect plus the same scaling-damage machinery as Judgement.
